summary: Iteration 61: Failure Mode Classification System Testing Complete. All 25 backend tests passed (100%). Verified: (1) _classify_failure() correctly classifies all 6 test cases (BUY -6% → MACRO_SHOCK, BUY -1.5% → TECH_FAKEOUT, SELL +1.2% → TECH_FAKEOUT, BUY -0.5% → REGIME_SHIFT, BUY -7% low_vol → LIQUIDITY_GAP, HOLD +5% → MACRO_SHOCK), (2) GET /api/accuracy/failure-modes returns all 5 categories, (3) GET /api/accuracy/failure-breakdown returns proper structure (empty since no verified wrong predictions), (4) POST /api/accuracy/classify/{id} validates prediction existence and failure_code, (5) save_regime() stores failure_code in ChromaDB metadata, (6) _regime_to_text() includes 'Failure Mode:' and 'Failure Reason:' lines, (7) get_strategist_veto_context() includes [FAILURE_CODE] tag in warnings, (8) nightly_cleanup preserves failure_code when re-tagging toxic entries.
critical_code_review_comments: _classify_failure() correctly implements heuristic-based classification: >=5% move → MACRO_SHOCK (or LIQUIDITY_GAP if low volume), <1% move → REGIME_SHIFT, 1-5% reversal → TECH_FAKEOUT
FAILURE_MODES dict contains all 5 categories with descriptive explanations
GET /api/accuracy/failure-modes requires auth but not Pro (any logged-in user can view)
GET /api/accuracy/failure-breakdown requires Pro subscription and returns aggregated failure stats
POST /api/accuracy/classify/{id} updates both MongoDB (verified_24h/verified_1w.failure_code) and ChromaDB metadata
save_regime() correctly adds failure_code to ChromaDB metadata when present in regime dict
_regime_to_text() includes 'Failure Mode:' and 'Failure Reason:' lines when failure_code/failure_reason present
get_strategist_veto_context() formats failure_code as [FAILURE_CODE] tag in warning lines
nightly_cleanup() uses meta.copy() to preserve existing metadata (including failure_code) when re-tagging toxic entries
verify_pending_predictions() auto-classifies failures using _classify_failure() and passes failure_code to save_regime()
seed_data_creation: TEST_FAIL_61 (miss with failure_code=MACRO_SHOCK) and TEST_TOXIC_FC (toxic_lesson with failure_code=TECH_FAKEOUT) added to ChromaDB for testing
